query:
SELECT
                        day as "day!",
                        stock as "stock!",
                        primary_exchange as "primary_exchange!",
                        currency as "currency!",
                        open as "open!",
                        high as "high!",
                        low as "low!",
                        close as "close!",
                        volume as "volume!"
                    FROM market_data.daily_ohlcv
                    WHERE stock = $1
                      AND primary_exchange = $2
                      AND currency = $3
                    ORDER BY day DESC
                    LIMIT $4
